reference.behavior: Merge fills zero-valued destinations, while mergeOverwrite accepts zero-valued sources.

request.name: dict-merge-zero-values
request.template: {{merge (dict "n" 0 "s" "" "b" false "l" (list)) (dict "n" 1 "s" "x" "b" true "l" (list 2)) | toJson}}|{{mergeOverwrite (dict "n" 1 "s" "x" "b" true "l" (list 2)) (dict "n" 0 "s" "" "b" false "l" (list)) | toJson}}
